Vanessa Williams: Live In Concert

Join the legendary Vanessa Williams as she takes to the road with her first full UK concert tour. Accompanied by her incredible band of world-class musicians, Vanessa will take you on her musical journey, from her 1988 chart debut, through to her latest album, via her iconic stage performances on Broadway and in London’s West End. Featuring music from Into The Woods, Kiss of the Spiderwoman and After Midnight, plus all her beloved hits including The Right Stuff, Colours of the Wind, The Sweetest Days, Running Back To You, Legs (Keep Dancing) and of course, Save The Best For Last, Vanessa will share stories from her illustrious career spanning music, film, TV and stage, with maybe a few surprises too! So, book now for this rare opportunity to see Vanessa Williams live in concert.

Tue 23 Feb 2027

Emeli Sandé: Celebrating 15 Years Of 'Our Version Of Events'

One of Britain’s most acclaimed and distinctive singer-songwriters Emeli Sandé has announced a monumental UK & EU tour to celebrate 15 years of her landmark debut album ‘Our Version of Events’. Emeli will be performing her celebrated x8 time platinum album in full alongside her greatest hits. Our Version of Events was the biggest selling album in the UK of 2012 and 2013, selling more than five million copies worldwide. It features much-loved hits including Next to Me, Read All About It (Pt. III) and Clown. Celebrated for its emotional depth and exceptional songwriting, it won British Album of the Year at the 2013 BRIT Awards, while Next to Me received two Ivor Novello Awards. The record spent an extraordinary 66 consecutive weeks in the UK Official Albums Chart Top 10, setting a record for the longest unbroken Top 10 run by a debut album, surpassing the 62-week run of The Beatles’ Please, Please Me. More than a decade after Our Version of Events first introduced her to the world, Emeli Sandé remains an artist with something to say — and a voice capable of making sure people listen. Doors open 7pm. Please check website nearer show date for confirmed start time. Premium Seat VIP Package: Your premium seat VIP package, celebrating 15 years since Emeli Sandé’s debut album, includes: A premium seated ticket with one of the best views in the venue. 15th anniversary gift celebrating this special milestone. Limited edition cotton tote bag. Pre signed anniversary tour poster featuring the original artwork from Emeli’s iconic album.
